task.title: Removing a tag
task.shortdesc: You can remove direct tags from individual station objects using the Remove dialog box.

context.note: This task does not apply to implied tags.

step.cmd: Right-click the object that you want to edit and choose Edit Tags from the menu.
From the Edit Tags dialog box, click Remove Tag.
step.stepresult: The Remove dialog box appears showing a list of all the Direct Tags that are assigned to the selected component.

step.cmd: Select the individual tags that you want to remove or choose Remove All and then click OK.
step.stepresult: The selected tags are removed from the table listing under the Direct Tags tab in the lower half of the dialog.Check that the appropriate tags are now listed in the Edit Tags lower pane, under the Direct Tags tab. Your deletions are not complete until you click Save. If you want to revoke the delete action, click Cancel.

step.cmd: To complete the task, click Save.

taskbody.result: The tag is removed from the selected object.
